prior_looks: Read supplied brief, source code, column schema, two catalogue rows and one NOAA row. No historical prices fetched and no hypothesis tests run before freeze. Prior satellite-null work supplied by brief.
universe: Existing completed weather catalogue and vol10k crawl only; closed binary outcomes, exactly one winner per weather event. Event dates through 2026-09-18. No recrawl.
sampling: Weather price-history target: all buckets in 2400 events, deterministic SHA256(event_slug) ordering within city/month/kind round-robin; try 30 token access probes across early/middle/recent eras before bulk. If all valid historical endpoint variants give empty series, suspend bulk and label price tests blocked. Descriptive station audit uses all eligible events. Other categories: up to 60 markets per fixed topic/category, hash ordering, no outcome-based ranking.
time_split: Fixed train through 2026-05-31, held-out 2026-06-01 through 2026-09-18 for weather. Other missions first 60% of distinct overlapping dates train, last 40% held out. No late-period tuning.
station_rules: Parse ICAO from WU path or NWS site query. Do not substitute airport for non-airport authority. Use IANA local time/DST. Accept NOAA original-source QC 0,1,4,5,9 or blank with no GHCNh flags; plausible -80..65 C. >=18 distinct local hours, coverage reaches <=02 and >=21. Event winner status requires exactly one terminal YES and all binary prices. Round floor(x+0.5) in stated units; ties sensitivity descriptive. Both early closed losers and later settled winners belong to the same local event date.
point_in_time: NOAA archive has no ingestion timestamps: intraday 30m assumed publication lag is a retrospective proxy only, not certified executable information. Weather certainty means elimination of finite buckets or entry into absorbing open tail; never label afternoon finite winning bucket certain. Price asof must be at/before cutoff and <=120m old for calibration, <=15m for intraday, no terminal snapshot backfill. Outcomes only score predictions. Final volume is audit metadata, never a historical signal or liquidity filter.
inference: 10,000 date-cluster bootstrap draws for mean score/error/return differences; null centered bootstrap two-sided p=(1+extreme)/(10001). Cluster on local date across cities, include all same-event buckets together. >=30 unique held-out dates and >=50 events otherwise insufficient. Serial robustness: 7-day moving block bootstrap CI, disclosed exploratory. Correlation tests use daily differences, 7-day block permutation and max absolute r over registered lag set, training-selected lag held fixed on late period; >=60 dates. BH over all 22 slots including blocked/insufficient as p=1. Supported only q<=.05 and expected sign (or sign=0).
power: For mean nulls, approximate 80% power two-sided MDE=(1.96+0.842)*SD(date means)/sqrt(n_dates); family-conservative MDE uses z(1-.05/(2*family_size))+0.842. Correlations: tanh((z+0.842)/sqrt(n_dates-3)). Undefined for inaccessible data, not zero.
controls: For every executable primary paired test, one seeded Rademacher sign flip of date-level effects followed by the identical 10,000 bootstrap test; report unadjusted placebo false-positive rate with denominator. Diagnostic mismatch also by city, source, season, max/min, completeness, and rounding, all descriptive. For correlation tests fixed 28-day signal shift placebo. No placebo counts when untestable.
costs: Never call price-history a bid/ask or fill. Audit public current fee-rate and order-book for representative live tokens, $100 size; current books cannot certify past costs. Historical bid/ask/size missing => historical tradability unverified. Report gross cents against illustrative 1/2/5-cent all-in costs only if gross edge measured, label assumptions.
access: Public GET only; disk cache all successful and failed requests; one request in flight per process and >=0.4s gap, exponential backoff for 429/5xx. Cached completed crawls immutable. No identity linkage, accounts, orders or credentials.

tests.title: Station threshold crossing predicts a price decline
tests.signal: Running maximum clears finite upper bucket bound (minimum clears lower bound), rounded in contract units
tests.target: YES price change in next 60 minutes
tests.mechanism: A monotone running extreme rules out a bucket; observations delayed 30 minutes; >=30 independent local dates
tests.primary_specification: A monotone running extreme rules out a bucket; observations delayed 30 minutes; >=30 independent local dates

tests.title: Day-ahead market beats persistence
tests.signal: Market price and prior-day station extreme distribution
tests.mechanism: Price pools information beyond lagged weather; persistence uses day d-2, the latest complete day at cutoff
tests.primary_specification: Price pools information beyond lagged weather; persistence uses day d-2, the latest complete day at cutoff

tests.title: Day-ahead market beats seasonal climatology
tests.signal: Market price versus trailing seasonal empirical distribution
tests.mechanism: Price incorporates forecast innovations; trailing +/-30 calendar-day season window, past dates only, >=30 days
tests.primary_specification: Price incorporates forecast innovations; trailing +/-30 calendar-day season window, past dates only, >=30 days

tests.title: Archived forecast improves on day-ahead market
tests.signal: Fixed-model GFS prior-run forecast, temperature_2m_previous_day3
tests.mechanism: Every target-day hour at 72h offset precedes the cutoff; early-period residual distribution produces bucket probabilities
tests.primary_specification: Every target-day hour at 72h offset precedes the cutoff; early-period residual distribution produces bucket probabilities

tests.title: Open-ended tail buckets are overpriced
tests.signal: Open-ended vs finite temperature buckets at day-ahead cutoff
tests.mechanism: Longshot demand inflates tails; compare within event; calibration uses residuals, not level correlation
tests.primary_specification: Longshot demand inflates tails; compare within event; calibration uses residuals, not level correlation

tests.title: Bucket-sum discrepancy subsequently contracts
tests.signal: Sum of all bucket YES prices minus one
tests.target: absolute discrepancy at +60m minus at cutoff
tests.mechanism: Complete partitions should normalize; all buckets must have nonstale histories
tests.primary_specification: Complete partitions should normalize; all buckets must have nonstale histories

tests.title: Prices update less overnight
tests.signal: Local night 00-06 versus day 12-18
tests.target: night minus day mean absolute hourly price change
tests.mechanism: Trader activity differs by local clock; weather information arrival is a confound
tests.primary_specification: Trader activity differs by local clock; weather information arrival is a confound

tests.title: Rounding explains station-settlement mismatch
tests.signal: Nearest integer in contract units versus unrounded extreme
tests.target: rounded mismatch indicator minus raw mismatch indicator
tests.mechanism: Display precision changes bucket classification; diagnostic only, no causal or trading interpretation
tests.primary_specification: Display precision changes bucket classification; diagnostic only, no causal or trading interpretation

tests.title: METAR-only observations better reproduce settlement
tests.signal: FM15/FM16 extreme versus all quality-passing observations
tests.mechanism: Different observation subsets can change daily extreme; diagnostic, not tradability
tests.primary_specification: Different observation subsets can change daily extreme; diagnostic, not tradability

tests.title: Dated news anchors concentrate market movement
tests.signal: Prelisted Iran timeline; Fed/election/hurricane/outage anchors where exact timestamps exist
tests.target: absolute return after minus before event
tests.mechanism: New information moves beliefs; date-only anchors use UTC day boundaries with no minute lead claims
tests.primary_specification: New information moves beliefs; date-only anchors use UTC day boundaries with no minute lead claims

tests.title: News innovations precede market revisions
tests.signal: Daily change in topic news count
tests.mechanism: Beliefs absorb news with delay; choose lag on early 60%, max-statistic null across all three
tests.primary_specification: Beliefs absorb news with delay; choose lag on early 60%, max-statistic null across all three

tests.title: Options divergence predicts crypto threshold drift
tests.signal: Matching digital probability from option call spread minus market
tests.mechanism: Public derivatives and prediction markets price the same terminal threshold; exact expiry/settlement match required
tests.primary_specification: Public derivatives and prediction markets price the same terminal threshold; exact expiry/settlement match required

tests.title: Cross-venue divergence predicts convergence

tests.mechanism: Identical payoff markets should converge; contract language and timestamp match required
tests.primary_specification: Identical payoff markets should converge; contract language and timestamp match required

tests.primary_specification: Same decision reprices across venues; keyless historical futures and contract-matched timestamps required

tests.mechanism: Same named storm and contract geography required
tests.primary_specification: Same named storm and contract geography required
